# Progression reference

## Levels

Reaching level 2 takes 300 XP; each further level takes 50 XP more than the one before. Each level-up pays 1,000 coins times the new level. Milestone packs are untradeable.

| Level | Total XP | Level-up coins | Milestone pack |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 300 | 2,000 |  |
| 3 | 650 | 3,000 |  |
| 4 | 1,050 | 4,000 |  |
| 5 | 1,500 | 5,000 | Premium Gold Pack |
| 6 | 2,000 | 6,000 |  |
| 7 | 2,550 | 7,000 |  |
| 8 | 3,150 | 8,000 |  |
| 9 | 3,800 | 9,000 |  |
| 10 | 4,500 | 10,000 | Rare Players Pack |
| 11 | 5,250 | 11,000 |  |
| 12 | 6,050 | 12,000 |  |
| 13 | 6,900 | 13,000 |  |
| 14 | 7,800 | 14,000 |  |
| 15 | 8,750 | 15,000 | Jumbo Premium Gold Pack |
| 16 | 9,750 | 16,000 |  |
| 17 | 10,800 | 17,000 |  |
| 18 | 11,900 | 18,000 |  |
| 19 | 13,050 | 19,000 |  |
| 20 | 14,250 | 20,000 | Mega Pack |
| 21 | 15,500 | 21,000 |  |
| 22 | 16,800 | 22,000 |  |
| 23 | 18,150 | 23,000 |  |
| 24 | 19,550 | 24,000 |  |
| 25 | 21,000 | 25,000 | Jumbo Rare Players Pack |
| 26 | 22,500 | 26,000 |  |
| 27 | 24,050 | 27,000 |  |
| 28 | 25,650 | 28,000 |  |
| 29 | 27,300 | 29,000 |  |
| 30 | 29,000 | 30,000 | Ultimate Pack |

After level 30, every 5th level repeats the Ultimate Pack.

## New club

| Grant | Contents |
|---|---|
| Starting squad | 1 gold from your favourite club (silver/bronze if none), 5 silver, 5 bronze starters; 4 silver and 8 bronze subs |
| Manager | Random bronze manager |
| Club items | favourite club badge, home and away kits, stadium (supplied rows; omitted when absent) |
| Welcome gift | 7,500 coins and 5 untradeable Premium Gold Packs, claimed from the welcome message |
